Terms of service

Read this fast.

Plain English. Last updated May 16, 2026.

What VoCal is

VoCal is a voice-first calorie tracking app. Speak what you ate, we log it with estimated macros. This is not medical advice and VoCal is not a medical device. If you have a medical condition, talk to a clinician.

Your data

Everything we collect is described in the Privacy Policy. Short version: your meals, photos, and voice transcripts belong to you. We use them to power the app and improve the AI estimates. We don't sell them.

Estimates are estimates

Calorie and macro numbers are best-effort estimates from chain menus, the USDA database, and AI vision. They can be wrong. Edit anything by tapping the meal.

Subscriptions

VoCal Pro is a subscription billed through the App Store. Manage or cancel from Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. Refunds are handled by Apple.

Subscriptions and auto-renewal

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the same price as the original purchase. You may manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renew by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

Account & deletion

Delete your account any time from Profile → Privacy → Delete account. We delete all your data within 30 days. No questions.

Acceptable use

Don't try to break VoCal, abuse the AI, or use it to harm yourself. If something looks off, email us — we're a small team and we read everything.

Changes

We'll tell you if anything material changes. Otherwise check this page or our support page.
